description: Every event type must answer a declared operational question within a bounded cost.

rightcontext.note: legacy alias for membrane; keep for installed event compatibility

turn.observed.question: Did every supported turn enter accounting?

provider.expected.question: Which providers should this turn have attempted?

provider.started.question: Did each expected provider actually start?

provider.terminal.question: How did every provider attempt terminate and how long did it take?

candidate.retrieved.question: What candidate volume and ranking did retrieval produce?

candidate.filtered.question: Why did retrieved candidates fail admission?

block.rendered.question: Was an admitted set rendered into a bounded block?

block.delivered.question: Did the rendered block reach the client?

delivery.failed.question: Which rendered blocks failed before client delivery?

candidate.used.question: Which delivered candidates have verified use evidence?

candidate.ignored.question: Which delivered candidates have verified non-use evidence?

candidate.contradicted.question: Which delivered candidates were contradicted by verified outcomes?

candidate.unknown.question: Which delivered candidates lack admissible value evidence?

turn.outcome.question: What frozen or verified outcome closes this turn?

write.requested.question: Did every requested durable mutation enter accounting?

embedding.started.question: Did embedding start for validated writes?

embedding.terminal.question: How did embedding terminate and at what cost?

commit.started.question: Did the local durable transaction start?

commit.terminal.question: Did the mutation and canonical event commit atomically?

export.started.question: Did a committed local event enter replication export?

peer_apply.started.question: Did a valid foreign event enter peer apply?

peer_apply.terminal.question: Did peer apply preserve convergence and local re-embedding?

feedback.recorded.question: Was receipt-linked feedback durably recorded without overwrite?

policy.assigned.question: Was every eligible session assigned exactly once?

policy.exposed.question: Which assigned policy was actually exposed?

replication.cursor.question: What peer high-water marks has this installation applied?

replication.health.question: Is this installation publishing current replication health?

identity.claimed.question: Which service instance owns this startup generation?

identity.retired.question: When did this service instance stop owning its startup generation?

identity.collision.question: Did cloned installations claim the same generation?

privacy.rejected.question: Which producer attempted to emit a forbidden field category?

outbox.shed.question: How much optional diagnostic detail was shed under backpressure?

reconcile.gap.question: Which required lifecycle or replication invariant is incomplete?

transform.started.question: Did a compaction or curation transform start?

transform.terminal.question: How did a compaction or curation transform terminate?
